# OpenAgent

> Performance marketing and social media management for businesses in Pakistan and the U.S., run by Abeer Nasir.

OpenAgent helps brands, e-commerce businesses, B2B companies and small businesses run paid campaigns with a defined objective and a social media presence that publishes consistently. Work is scoped in writing before it starts.
